summary: Explains how RFC authors should write the IANA Considerations section. Many protocols have fields whose values must be assigned without clashing, and IANA keeps those registries. This document defines a framework for stating the policies under which new values may be added or changed. It replaces RFC 5226.

eli5.summary: Think of a school locker room with numbered lockers. This is the rule book for how new lockers get handed out, so two kids never get the same one.

questions: how to write an iana considerations section
